remarks_1999: Double entries Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive. Abiquiú Notebooks and Whitney Archive indicate, "Exam. at Mrs. Liebman's apartment, Jan. 1946.. .. No signature. Did not see back of picture." Whitney Archive indicates, "Miss O'Keeffe says this is petunia and coleus." Abiquiú Notebooks after 1976 indicates, "Sold by Halpert to Mayer, March 1960." Titled *Petunia* in *The Arts* (April 1925). (Source: Lynes, 1999)
